method: Close urban walls are supported by the supplied Mirabeau and hairpin views at 342 and 534 seconds. Widths are reconstructed, not surveyed. Native racing centreline, elevations, banking and road widths remain unchanged.
escape_review: The retained visual runoff ranges are 210–275 m and 2100–2240 m. Neither overlaps these sections. Mirabeau Haute at 1183 m and its earlier escape lie before the taper beginning at 1185 m.
